"use client";

import type { CategoryNode } from "@/lib/category-tree";
import Link from "next/link";
import { usePathname } from "next/navigation";

// Aktywna kategoria wynika z URL, więc zaznaczenie działa po kliknięciu, po F5 i przy cofaniu
export function CategoryTree({ tree, total }: { tree: CategoryNode[]; total: number }) {
  const pathname = usePathname();

  return (
    <nav aria-label="Kategorie" className="grid gap-2">
      <NavItem href="/catalog" label="Wszystkie produkty" count={total} active={pathname === "/catalog"} />
      <TreeList nodes={tree} pathname={pathname} />
    </nav>
  );
}

function TreeList({
  nodes,
  pathname,
  depth = 0,
}: {
  nodes: CategoryNode[];
  pathname: string;
  depth?: number;
}) {
  return (
    <ul className={`grid gap-1 text-sm ${depth > 0 ? "ml-3 border-l pl-3" : ""}`}>
      {nodes.map((node) => {
        const href = `/catalog/${node.path.join("/")}`;
        return (
          <li key={node.id}>
            <NavItem href={href} label={node.name} count={node.count} active={pathname === href} />
            {node.children.length > 0 && (
              <TreeList nodes={node.children} pathname={pathname} depth={depth + 1} />
            )}
          </li>
        );
      })}
    </ul>
  );
}

function NavItem({
  href,
  label,
  count,
  active,
}: {
  href: string;
  label: string;
  count: number;
  active: boolean;
}) {
  return (
    <Link
      href={href}
      aria-current={active ? "page" : undefined}
      className={`flex items-center justify-between gap-2 rounded-md px-2 py-1 text-sm transition-colors ${
        active
          ? "bg-muted font-medium text-foreground"
          : "text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground"
      }`}
    >
      <span>{label}</span>
      <span className="text-xs tabular-nums">{count}</span>
    </Link>
  );
}
```
</details></tool-use>

import { Breadcrumbs } from "@/components/Breadcrumbs";
import { buildTree, productsFor, resolveChain } from "@/lib/category-tree";
import { getAllProducts, getCategories } from "@/services/CatalogAPI";
import { notFound } from "next/navigation";
import { Suspense } from "react";
import { ProductGrid } from "../ProductGrid";

// params to dane runtime: strona wysyła shell, a ścieżkę sprawdza i produkty dociąga w granicy
export default function CategoryPage(
  props: PageProps<"/catalog/[...categories]">,
) {
  return (
    <Suspense
      fallback={<p className="text-muted-foreground">Ładowanie produktów kategorii…</p>}
    >
      <CategoryContent params={props.params} />
    </Suspense>
  );
}

async function CategoryContent({
  params,
}: {
  params: Promise<{ categories: string[] }>;
}) {
  const { categories } = await params;
  const [categoriesData, products] = await Promise.all([
    getCategories(),
    getAllProducts(),
  ]);

  // nieznana ścieżka (np. stary /catalog/nowosci) daje 404, a pusta kategoria zostaje z komunikatem
  const chain = resolveChain(buildTree(categoriesData, products), categories);
  if (!chain) notFound();

  const leaf = chain[chain.length - 1];
  const crumbs = [
    { label: "Sklep", href: "/catalog" },
    ...chain.map((node, i) => ({
      label: node.name,
      href:
        i < chain.length - 1 ? `/catalog/${node.path.join("/")}` : undefined,
    })),
  ];

  return (
    <>
      <Breadcrumbs items={crumbs} />
      <h1 className="mb-4 text-xl font-semibold">
        {leaf.name}{" "}
        <span className="text-base font-normal text-muted-foreground">
          ({leaf.count})
        </span>
      </h1>
      <ProductGrid products={productsFor(products, leaf)} />
    </>
  );
}
```
</details></tool-use>

# Plan: move the category nav into a `@sidebar` parallel route

## Problem
`src/app/(ecommerce)/(catalog-nav)/layout.tsx` renders `CategoryNav` directly in its `<aside>`. The nav is the same for every child route, so it cannot vary per section (catalog vs product). Moving it into a parallel slot lets each section supply its own sidebar.

## Approach
Use a parallel slot `@sidebar` under `(catalog-nav)`, mirroring the existing `account/@modal` pattern.

- `(catalog-nav)/layout.tsx`: accept a `sidebar` prop and render it inside the existing `<aside>`. Keep the grid and aside wrapper in the layout.
- `(catalog-nav)/@sidebar/default.tsx`: fallback slot (returns `null`), used when no sidebar matches the URL, e.g. `/catalog/nowosci` or `/product/[...slugs]`.
- `(catalog-nav)/@sidebar/catalog/page.tsx` and `(catalog-nav)/@sidebar/catalog/[...categories]/page.tsx`: render the category nav (`CategoryNav`) with the catalog version.
- `(catalog-nav)/@sidebar/product/[id]/page.tsx`: product version of the sidebar (content TBD).
- Keep `CategoryNav` and `CategoryTree` in `catalog/`; slot pages import them. No component moves, so the diff stays small.
- Each slot page keeps its own `<Suspense>` boundary, since params are runtime data under `cacheComponents`.

## Todos
1. `layout-slot-prop`: add `sidebar` prop to `(catalog-nav)/layout.tsx` and render it in `<aside>`.
2. `sidebar-default`: create `@sidebar/default.tsx` returning `null`.
3. `sidebar-catalog`: create `@sidebar/catalog/page.tsx` and `@sidebar/catalog/[...categories]/page.tsx` rendering `CategoryNav` in Suspense.
4. `sidebar-product`: create `@sidebar/product/[id]/page.tsx` with the product sidebar (depends on answer to Q1).
5. `validate`: run `npx tsc --noEmit`, then `npm run build`; check `/catalog`, `/catalog/nowosci`, `/catalog/<category>`, `/product/<id>` and a hard refresh on each in the browser.

## Dependencies
- `sidebar-catalog`, `sidebar-product` depend on `layout-slot-prop` and `sidebar-default`.
- `validate` depends on all of the above.

## Open questions
- Content of the product sidebar.
- Whether the slot should stay limited to `(catalog-nav)`, or cover the whole `(ecommerce)` tree.
- Whether `/catalog` should keep a sidebar, given it redirects to `/catalog/nowosci`.
